reviews.text: Wide range, found what I needed for my kitten, staff are helpful and listen.

Helpful, friendly service, good selection & very decent prices when compared to online alternatives. I especially like how big the selection of natural treats & food is. There is a surprisingly broad selection of everything you need for a pet in a relatively small space. My kids like to watch the fish while I shop for our dog.
Please note! Prices on the shelves do not correspond to prices at the checkout!
The store is not big, but the owner (i think) was very nice and recommended me some bigger pet stores ✨️😊 …
Relatively small pet shop, but they have everything.
Friendly staff. Small shop with veeeery many items.

There is a lady working here who doesn't know how to sell fish and therefore refuses to sell (first with the excuse that they don't sell fish after 3:00 PM, even though the shop doesn't close until 6:00 PM). A very strange person and incredibly rude. It might be interesting for the owner to know that my visit took place on August 19th (at 3:30 PM hahaha). Truly a very strange visit.
Great !! Found TIMO products that I needed

A super grumpy employee really had absolutely no desire to help me with dog food. I asked if they had it, and he just said “no” and waved me away as if I should get lost — just as I had walked into the store. But it turned out they actually did have the food I was looking for! The service here is bizarrely bad. It's really not normal.

Bought a toy today and it's already broken, and that for 15 euros!

If you want some real junk for your money, go here!

We were there today (Sunday, January 5th) and the woman working there was incredibly helpful. My son now has everything he needs to keep guppies, and she was immediately given a good explanation of everything we need to consider. She was really excited, and we left very happy.
They have everything I need for my cat
The employees are not interested in helping you choose your items and are rude. I will not be returning to this store. 😡 …
